newsitem.title: USA: BWAY sees more non-recurring charges in 97.
newsitem.headline: BWAY sees more non-recurring charges in 97.

text.p: BWAY Corp on Monday said it expected to post further charges against its operating income in fiscal 1997.
The company did not provide details about the expected charges, and officials could not be reached immediately Monday evening for comment.
On Monday the company said first-quarter earnings rose to $0.49 a share from $0.46 in the year-earlier period. Revenues rose $100 million from nearly $62 million.

"Although certain rationalization costs associated with the recent acquisitions have been accrued for through purchase accounting adjustments, the company has and will continue to incur other non-recurring costs in fiscal 1997 which will be charged against operating income," the company statement said.

It attributed improvement in net sales to the acquisition of Ball Corp's aerosol can business in the first quarter of 1997, and the acquisitions of Milton Can Co Inc and Davies Can in the third quarter of 1996.

It said moves to integrate the acquired facilities include closing a plant in Memphis, Tennessee, and moving operations into a new facility in the quarter and steps at other plants to cut costs and improve efficiencies.

"In support of these initiatives, capital investment for the second quarter of 1997 totaled $5.9 million, and is estimated to approach $20 million for full year fiscal 1997," the company said in a release.
